data.text:
Taiyyab Ali vs State Of M.P. on 4 January, 2024 
Author: Prakash Chandra Gupta
Bench: Prakash Chandra Gupta 
 1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE  BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA  ON THE 4 th OF JANUARY, 2024  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 9236 of 2019  BETWEEN:- 
 1. TAIYYAB ALI S/O AKBAR ALI BOHRA, AGED  ABOUT 72 YEARS, OCCUPATION: KIRANA STORES  SAIFI KIRANA SOTRES, DHAR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 2. FIRM SEFI KIRANA STORES BOHRA BAKHAL  BOHARA BAKHAL, DHAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI NILESH MANORE, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE APPELLANTS.) 
 AND  STATE OF M.P. THROUGH SANJEEV KUMAR MISHRA  FOOD SECURITY OFFICER FOODA AND DRUGS  ADMINISTRATION DHAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .. 
 (SHRI KAPIL MAHANT, LEARNED P.L. FOR THE STATE.)
 This appeal coming on for judgement this day, the Court  following:
 JUDGEMENT This appeal has been filed by the appellant/accused person under section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 being aggrieved by the order dated 23.09.2019 passed in M.C.A No.36/2018 passed by the District Judge, Food Safety Appeal Abhikaran, District-Dhar. 
2. Learned counsel for the State submitted that report dated 31.12.2023 is received from S.H.O.,
Dhar and as per the report appellant no.1 Taiyyab Ali S/o Akbhar Ali Bohra, died on 24.04.2021. 
The report is supported by death certificate. 
3. Learned counsel for the appellant also submitted that sole proprietor Taiyyab Ali (appellant no.1)
of firm Saifi Kirana Store has been died therefore, appeal has been abated. 
Taiyyab Ali vs State Of M.P. on 4 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138002331/
1 4 . I n view of death of appellant no.1 Taiyyab Ali so also the death certificate, the present appeal is abated. Accordingly, present appeal stands dismissed, as abated. 
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Taiyyab Ali vs State Of M.P. on 4 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138002331/ 
2
